AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.zhs: 登录失败，请检查用户名和密码。
AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS.en: Sign-in failed. Check your account and password.

AUTH_ADMISSION_DENIED.zhs: 账号当前不满足登录条件，请联系管理员确认账号和业务身份。
AUTH_ADMISSION_DENIED.en: This account is not eligible to sign in. Contact your administrator to check your account and business identity.

AUTH_SESSION_TIME_ZONE_INVALID.zhs: 当前时区无效，请检查设备时区设置后重试。
AUTH_SESSION_TIME_ZONE_INVALID.en: Your time zone is invalid. Check your device time-zone settings and try again.

AUTH_PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_BUSY.zhs: 登录请求较多，请稍后重试。
AUTH_PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_BUSY.en: Sign-in is busy. Please try again shortly.

AUTH_SESSION_INVALID.zhs: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录后重试。
AUTH_SESSION_INVALID.en: Your session has expired. Sign in and try again.

AUTH_SESSION_ROTATION_FAILED.zhs: 密码已修改，但新会话无法确认，请重新登录。
AUTH_SESSION_ROTATION_FAILED.en: Your password changed, but the new session could not be confirmed. Sign in again.

AUTH_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE.zhs: 网络暂时不可用，请检查连接后重试。
AUTH_NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE.en: The network is unavailable. Check your connection and retry.

AUTH_SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.zhs: 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。
AUTH_SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.en: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

AUTH_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE.zhs: 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。
AUTH_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE.en: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

AUTHORIZATION_DECISION_UNAVAILABLE.en: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

AUTH_CREDENTIAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.zhs: 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。
